== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Guilds are a collection of ten influential organizations that serve as the primary pillars of The Empire{{!}}the Empire. Historically, these groups have functioned as a private governing force, managing the world through their specialized expertise while maintaining an outdated imperial system. While some view them as essential for stability, others criticize them for propping up old power structures or acting as mere mercenaries driven by profit. The Guilds are divided into various categories, including independent groups such as the [[Alchemists]], [[Consultants]], [[Greenwardens]], and the [[Luminian Order]], as well as others like the [[Magisters]], [[Champions]], Navigators, Witnesses, and the [[Blackwatch]]. Some organizations, such as the [[Imperial Guard]], have lower entry requirements compared to elite groups, while others like the [[Greenwardens]] possess unique abilities, such as being [[Soulbound]] and capable of healing or agricultural restoration. Leadership within certain Guilds is tied to the ability to bond with specific historical vessels, and many groups maintain their own internal methods for carrying out executions. Despite their immense power and wealth, the Guilds face modern challenges including political shifts from rising governors, internal hierarchy disputes, and external threats from the [[Great Elders]].}}
